page.summary: Use a still-standing pallet only when the pickup or carry will pass through its stun position and you are already close enough to time it.

verdict.recommendation: Confirm the pallet, carry path and your timing before leaving an objective; this is a narrow itemless opportunity.
verdict.soloQ: Take visible nearby pallet-save chances, not a map-wide chase for geometry you cannot control.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call the usable pallet and saver position so the team does not duplicate the attempt or spend the resource early.
verdict.mainWeakness: The Killer can avoid the pallet, change pickup position or use a route that never offers a stun.

opening: Check that the pallet still stands and that the down or carry path actually intersects it; no perk or item is required by this record.

rows.situation: A teammate goes down near a standing pallet and you can reach its safe side before the pickup or carry passes.
rows.action: Position to see the Killer's actual movement through the pallet rather than dropping it as soon as the teammate falls.
rows.why: The resource only saves if the stun intersects the pickup or carry window.

rows.situation: The Killer is committed to carrying the teammate through the usable pallet.
rows.action: Drop the pallet when its stun can interrupt the carry, then leave room for the freed teammate to escape.
rows.why: A well-timed standing-pallet stun can deny a hook without a carried item, but consumes the pallet.

rows.situation: The pallet was already spent, the Killer avoids it, or the carry has moved beyond reach.
rows.action: Do not chase the carry for another pallet; return to repair or plan a hook rescue.
rows.why: Once the geometry is gone, this save method has no remaining leverage at that spot.

abortWhen: The Killer does not carry through a standing pallet or you cannot reach its stun position in time.
The save would require wasting a useful pallet without a realistic carry interruption.

weaknesses: Exact geometry and timing make activation unreliable; using the pallet also spends a chase resource.
commonMistakes: Dropping the pallet at the down rather than at the Killer's carry crossing.
Waiting beside a spent pallet or chasing after the carry has left the tile.
